messages:
alex: quick heads-up — ran a tiny warm-start vs cold-start similarity probe for the new vector variant. goal: sanity-check recall@5 and cluster cohesion before handing off to bench team.

tara: nice. which model/config did you test?

alex: 6-bit quantized bert-lite (custom head), prefix cache enabled for warm-start. batch=64, shards=2. small wiki holdout ~2k queries.

jin: how are you measuring recall? exact kNN on cosine or approximate?

alex: exact cosine for this run to avoid ANN noise. recall@1/5/10 and silhouette for cluster sanity.

indra: can you paste the quick numbers?

eval-bot: run #1749987651 started by alex — status: completed — artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/warmstart-mini/1749987651/

alex: results snippet:
```
recall@1: 0.58
recall@5: 0.76
recall@10: 0.82
silhouette: 0.21
avg_latency_per_query_warm: 12ms
avg_latency_per_query_cold: 29ms
```

tara: recall@5 looks ok for a tiny holdout, latency improvement from caching is solid. what's baseline?

alex: baseline (previous prod tiny model) recall@5=0.78, latency ~18ms (no prefix cache). so slight delta in quality (-0.02) but warmer p99s and lower cost.

jin: did you check category-wise drop? longtail queries?

alex: yes — most hits clustered to shorter queries; for longtail (len>60 tokens) recall@5 drops to 0.61. might be an artifact of the reduced head capacity in quant.

indra: actionables? prefer quality over perf for customer-facing routes.

tara: propose: keep new variant as tiered candidate behind a rollout flag for internal routes only. run larger stratified eval next.

alex: +1. i'll queue a 50k stratified run (lang mixes + query len buckets) and add per-class reports. tagging @jin for deep cluster checks.

jin: ack. also add compression sanity — compare L2 vs cosine (just in case).

alex: noted. pushing follow-up ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/ML-2348 (draft)

eval-bot: job queued: stratified-50k-1749987700 (owner: alex)

indra: thanks — please post the full artifacts when done and ping bench team for canary plan. :thumbsup:

alex: will do. closing this quick thread, will report back with expanded numbers.
